title: Python: the four in-design blind-sample misses (attrs 16/23 annotated converter receiver; luigi 68 cls-inherited; luigi 37 self to module function)
description: From GCLI-174 scored run (DEC-303 (a110)). These are in-design misses, not the Q2 self.attr class and not the gate: attrs drawIndex 16 and 23 (a receiver converter annotated converter: Converter in src/attr/_make.py, the call missed), luigi drawIndex 68 (a classmethod reached through cls where the definition is inherited through the MRO), and luigi drawIndex 37 (self.check_complete where check_complete is a module-level function, not a class method). Each shape must first be reproduced on a FIXTURE, never on the spent sample; the spent sample code is not read for design (DEC-303 (a36) item 8; (a109) item 2). Nothing is built for self.attr (Q2) or for the gate; the operator choice dec-0y1zsed is pending. No hold; the start is permitted, fixtures only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A fixture reproduces the annotated-receiver shape (a parameter annotated with a class, a call through it) as a miss at the frozen head, and the fix resolves it; the fixture is the ground truth, not the spent sample.

A fixture reproduces the cls-inherited shape (a classmethod reached through cls where the definition is inherited) as a miss at the frozen head, and the fix resolves it; the fixture is the ground truth.

A fixture reproduces the self-to-module-function shape (self.<name> where <name> is a module-level function, not a class method) as a miss at the frozen head, and the fix resolves it; the fixture is the ground truth.
No spent blind-sample checkout is read to design or prove the fix, and nothing is built for self.attr (Q2) or the gate while dec-0y1zsed is pending.
